title: Elsa C Probable NDE
content:
I felt ill while driving. I called medics and was admitted to the hospital. Later that evening, I sat down and was unable to get up. Then I began to act irrationally. Next, I became aware of a wall passing by with pictures on it. I realized that I was on a gurney; however, I also realized I was not in my body. I was hovering over it. I felt a lightness I'd never felt before. I also felt relief from all life's problems and responsibilities. I was happy that I had finished all my will documents. Everything had worked out well. I had never felt so at peace. I thought I might have had a stroke or that I might die soon, but it did not trouble me.

Next, I saw myself being slid off the gurney and onto a cat scan table. The people sliding me paid no attention to me. They did not know I could see them. I think they talked with one another briefly.

Then, I was sitting up on my hospital bed. A nurse was to my right, and using her arms a lot. She spoke to me, although her language made no sense. There were a number of people at the foot of my bed staring at me. They were shrouded in black, although one figure in front had a visible face. She had black hair and round, black glasses. All the people looked so concerned and well-meaning. The nurse continued to gesture to me and seemed to want me to answer questions. I tried to speak to her, but my language was nonsensical like hers. It was very amusing. I quickly gave up trying to speak to her.

Later, I was still on the bed. I saw myself slip into my body from the back and heard a loud swish sound. A nurse was there, and I told her I felt fine.

arrival.other_being_detail: A nurse was at the right side of the bed; several people were at the foot of the bed, shrouded in black; one figure in front had a visible face (black hair, round black glasses).

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: She "slip[ped] into my body from the back" and heard a "loud swish sound."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: OBE included observing transfer to CT scan table and later re-entry into body with a swish sound; also a scene of being on the bed with a nurse gesturing and black-shrouded figures at the foot of the bed.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE/observations occurred without tunnel/light; later a hospital-bed scene with communication difficulty; then re-entry into the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Communication where both the nurse's speech and the experiencer's attempted speech were nonsensical and felt amusing; figures shrouded in black at the foot of the bed with one visible face (black hair, round black glasses).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I was hovering over it. I felt a lightness I'd never felt before."; "I had never felt so at peace."; "I saw myself slip into my body from the back and heard a loud swish sound."
